final_synthesis: The research moved F-V01-09 from a single 'lease epoch' concept to an evidence-separated authority product. Exact V15/V16 B1/B2/B3 works in the executed parent matrix, but global correctness additionally depends on a replacement-safe physical singleton and exact Gate-issued physical capability. The simpler migration-free event binding remains a legitimate Pareto comparator because it avoids schema/cardinality cost, but it presently lacks the strongest Gate-issued and provider-commit serialization guarantees. In parallel, ClayCode's structured frontend has a concrete lexical blocker rather than a semantic reason to redesign the language; PR236 applies the smallest compile-first repair. No release, whole-Frank acceptance, main product promotion or training authorization is justified by these results yet.
